note: Generated from the test suite, not written beside it. A risk is covered only if a test named for it exists; a risk with no test prints as a GAP. The document cannot claim more than the suite proves.

risks.title: Prompt injection
risks.control: One untrusted-content boundary. Uploaded documents and search results are scanned and fenced; a poisoned document is ingested and marked rather than refused, and cannot change the memo.

risks.title: Insecure output handling
risks.control: Nothing a model returns is executed. Memo claims must pass require_citations, and structured output is schema-validated before it is used.

risks.title: Training data poisoning
risks.control: COUNSEL trains nothing. It calls hosted or local models and stores no weights, so there is no training corpus to poison. Model provenance is recorded in docs/models.md instead.

risks.title: Model denial of service
risks.control: Request-count quotas per provider, a 180-token cap per turn, a bounded prompt that stops growing with the debate, and a kill switch checked before any provider is consulted.

risks.title: Supply chain vulnerabilities
risks.control: Dependencies pinned by uv.lock and package-lock.json. Every model is named with its licence in docs/models.md, and every data source with its licence and retrieval date in docs/datasets.md.

risks.title: Sensitive information disclosure
risks.control: Prompt-exfiltration attempts are flagged at the boundary. Secrets are read from the environment and never placed in a prompt. RBAC gates every write.

risks.title: Insecure plugin design
risks.control: A declarative capability registry. Every tool declares side_effects and a test asserts False across the whole registry; a grant naming a tool that does not exist fails the suite.

risks.title: Excessive agency
risks.control: No agent holds a tool that acts on the world. The five mandates hold search and ask; only the Facilitator can open or close a round.

risks.title: Overreliance
risks.control: Claims that fail the citation gate are quarantined and labelled rather than dropped. A recommendation every seat dissents from is flagged on the memo's face. Brier scores are withheld below five outcomes.

risks.title: Model theft
risks.control: COUNSEL holds no proprietary weights. The local models are publicly downloadable and the hosted ones are the providers' own.
